channel.title: Book of the undead
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Book of the undead" - The idea is about a book with the ability to revive people.

item.title: Re: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello! Not an official critter here, but I can still read and give opinions.
And in my opinion this is kinda… nothing? It feels very much like a Series I article and even then a kind of very basic one.
It feels like an "object that does a thing", in this case a 'book that does a revive'.
Nowadays, skips need a bit more than just that to work, I'm afraid.

Specifically, you need a story! Something to make a reader go 'wow, this SCP has something to say for itself! It exists in a world and has a purpose and the conflicts/events it causes do have an effect!".
Or something like that.
What I'm trying to say is- ok, this book revives people. Is it a relic of an ancient civilization? Is it something a guy who could do some supernatural stuff cooked up to resurrect his dead cat? What is that creature, anyway? What's its correlation to the SCP?
Not every SCP Object's gotta kill you dead, after all. I'd argue a few of my favorite skips, in fact, do not do so at all.

These are just a few points you could try answering, and I'm sure as you do more will pop up in your head! Remember, there are no ideas not worth exploring. Even if you don't pursue that thread in the end, it's more worldbuilding- it helps paint a clearer picture of your story in your head!

item.title: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP article

Genre: Mystery, Horror

Page Layout: standard
Elevator Pitch:
Book made out of unknown harmful substance discovered in Serbia, Nis in 2010 appears to have the ability to resurrect the deceased people for an undetermined period of time.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: If the same deceased person is attempted to be resurrected twice a very durable creature will possess their body and begin hunting down everything in its sight.
